title: StereoLinker — Max/Energy/Avg/DualMono, link percentage, mono safety
description:
Implement Source/DSP/StereoLinker as a control-rate stereo link matrix for detector envelopes and/or per-channel gains per CHUGGATE_SPEC §18.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md section 18 (linking modes, link percentage λ blend, mono safety divergence warning)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for stereo.linkMode and stereo.linkAmount
- Existing detector/gain types (envelopes, linear gain) so APIs accept float L/R pairs without owning the full state machine

Implement StereoLinker.h/.cpp per spec §18:
- Modes: Max E_link = max(E_L, E_R); Energy E_link = sqrt((E_L² + E_R²)/2); Average E_link = (E_L + E_R)/2; DualMono (independent — no shared envelope/gain forcing).
- For envelope linking: given E_L, E_R produce linked detector level(s) for Max/Energy/Average; DualMono returns the pair unchanged.
- Link percentage λ ∈ [0,1]: after computing linked or per-channel gains G_L, G_R and optional G_linked from the shared path,
  G_L' = λ * G_linked + (1-λ) * G_L; G_R' = λ * G_linked + (1-λ) * G_R.
  When DualMono, λ does not force linkage (document; λ may still be stored).
- API surface suitable for processBlock: setMode, setLinkAmount, linkEnvelopes(E_L, E_R) → linked E or pair; linkGains(G_L, G_R, G_linked_or_from_shared) → G_L', G_R'.
- Mono safety (§18.3): track recent |G_L'−G_R'| (or envelope divergence under DualMono) over a short window; expose isMonoSafetyWarning() / getDivergenceMetric() when dual-mono gating produces frequent L/R gain divergence above a documented threshold on a stereo bus. Warning only — do not auto-force link mode.
- prepare/reset optional if windowed metrics need SR; no heap allocation on the audio/control path after prepare.
- Mono input: safe pass-through (single channel treated as linked with itself).

Do NOT edit PluginProcessor or CMakeLists.txt. Do NOT write tests (g.5).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: StereoLinker implements Max, Energy, Average, and DualMono link modes per spec §18.1 formulas
Link percentage λ blends G_linked with per-channel gains: G' = λ*G_linked + (1-λ)*G_channel
Mono safety warning API flags frequent L/R gain divergence under dual-mono stereo use
No heap allocation in the per-block process/link path after prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: operate at control/block rate on float envelopes and gains
choose a documented divergence threshold and hold time for mono safety warning
treat mono as trivial single-channel pass-through
forbidden: auto-switch modes when mono safety warns
